text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the Debut Selection Race, where horsegirls
showcase their skills to earn scouts from Trainers.

The stands were packed with general spectators cheering them on before their debut,
other horsegirls, and sharp-eyed Trainers evaluating every move.

text_block_list.name: Female Ryan Fan
text_block_list.text: Ryaaan, we're rooting for you!! Give it your all!!

text_block_list.name: Male Ryan Fan
text_block_list.text: Show us that powerhouse running of yours!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Thanks so much!!
I'll do my best!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wow... You're as popular as ever, Ryan-chan~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I do laps around the academy grounds every day,
so I end up greeting folks and making friends with a lot of them.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And seeing you working so hard every day
makes everyone just want to cheer you on♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's a little embarrassing when you put it like that...
but I'm really grateful for the support. Gotta give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm not gonna lose to you either!
...Though my race isn't until the next round.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, guess our showdown will have to wait!
Well, it's about time for my heat. See ya later, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yup! Go get 'em!!

Mejiro Ryan went off to prepare for the race,
but watching her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, almost time...!
I wonder how far my current self can take me... Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...What's so funny at a time like this?
This is a critical race. Take it seriously.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh... S-Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Don't mind her. She's from a pretty prestigious family.
She's carrying the family honor on her shoulders, so she's on edge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Family honor...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: And now, the racers have entered the starting gates!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Family honor, huh...)
(—CLANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —?! Sh-Shoot...!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Mejiro Ryan is off to a terrible start!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah...!! Damn it...!!

text_block_list.name: Male Ryan Fan
text_block_list.text: Go, go, Ryaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Female Ryan Fan
text_block_list.text: You can still catch up! Don't give uuup!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Here they come, heading into the final stretch!!
Ryan, having clawed her way back from a bad start, moves up to second place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ah...! The girl in front... it's her...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The finish line is in sight! Ryan is chasing! Ryan gives chase!
Ryan is giving everything she has, but—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—She can't reach! The leader crosses the fiiinish line!!
Mejiro Ryan finishes in second place!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Wait...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan seemed kinda off just now.
How should I put it—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Her usual sharpness was entirely absent.
That was hardly a run worthy of Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, McQueen-chan! You came to watch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as I will be participating in the next race.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I must speak with her for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! W-Wait up!
If you're going to Ryan-chan, I'm coming too!

Together with Ines Fujin and Mejiro McQueen,
I headed over to where Mejiro Ryan was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer? And Ines... even McQueen?!
What's with the welcoming committee...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'what's with'?! What happened to YOU, Ryan-chan?
From the start all the way to the finish, you weren't acting like yourself at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well, that's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Selection Races are tough to win, after all!
Everyone's dead serious, all fired up to make sure they debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they just had more heart than me.
At the end of the day... when you get down to it, I just like working out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: With a reason like that, I guess it makes sense... right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A reason like that...? Ryan-chan, you work so hard and train
every single day! You shouldn't talk about yourself like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, well... Yeah, I just didn't train hard enough!
Not just physically, but mentally too. I've gotta push myself even harder!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan, if I may.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah? What is it, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why... did you come to Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies. That was an indelicate question.
If you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! W-Wait, McQueen-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Why"... huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hearing that from you really stings, McQueen...

In the end, Mejiro Ryan quickly left as well,
leaving no chance for a proper conversation...
